description: Low-cost benchmark matrix for provider evaluation

cases.prompt: Generate 3 Grade 3 multiple-choice questions on place value and number forms. Do not include image prompts unless strictly needed. Return strict JSON.
qualityChecklist: Correct answer index points to valid option

cases.prompt: Generate 3 Grade 4 fraction questions where at least one question requires a visual model. Return strict JSON with visualIntent whenever imagePrompt is present.
qualityChecklist: At least one question includes aligned visualIntent+imagePrompt
Visuals are directly related to question logic

cases.prompt: Given a student solved 2 of 5 medium-difficulty place-value questions, return JSON with identifiedGaps, subSkills, confidenceScore, and summary.
qualityChecklist: Includes identified gaps with actionable descriptions

cases.prompt: Given a Grade 5 student missed most fraction equivalence items and all decimal conversion items, return JSON analysis focused on misconceptions and remediation priorities.
Create 3 remedial slides for Grade 3 place value with clear vocabulary and instructional progression. Include imagePrompt only when necessary.
qualityChecklist: Slides scaffold from easier to harder

cases.prompt: Create 3 remedial slides for Grade 4 fractions. At least one slide should use an aligned visual model prompt tied to vocabulary and objective.
qualityChecklist: At least one slide uses instructional visual

cases.prompt: A clean 2D rectangle divided into 8 equal parts with exactly 3 shaded blue parts, no text.
